credits.source: Halo Online Map Pack For Halo 3

patch.scope: Private shader-only patch. No geometry, placements, materials values or flare changes. Native validation pending.

capture_reviews.review: Corrugated panels visibly rendered; focused static view passes.
Terrain beside opaque grate visibly lit/textured; focused regression view passes.
Rocky overlook with rifle HUD. Intended river detail not reached or not demonstrated; validation incomplete.

terrain_gpu.scope:
Summarize observed CPU lightmap vectors and GPU pixel constants in a draw trace.

CPU preparation and GPU submission are asynchronous. Their simultaneous snapshots
are not a per-command correspondence. Transitions refer to GPU draw order only.

corrugated_gpu.scope: Matching shader bytecode identities and observed GPU registers. Shared terrain variants may occur on several materials; use named constants/textures and geometry to identify the affected draw.

limits: Only reflected globals and explicitly reserved native blocks audited; not all engine registers.
River127 trace files are empty and the process is no longer live; terminal exit and hash checks not recovered. Capture is an overlook, not a useful water-detail view. No water acceptance.
Static captures do not establish splash animation, moving parallax, audio, broad traversal/Forge behavior, console or System Link compatibility.
Full rebuild remains gated by pending flare-layout decision. No installation or push.
